description: This PHP class implements the RefreshTokenRepositoryInterface for OAuth2 token management in the application, handling creation, persistence, revocation, and validation of refresh tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements refresh token handling functions such as creation, persistence, revocation, and validation for OAuth2 tokens within the system.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token, updating the corresponding OAuth2Tokens record with the refresh token data.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks the specified refresh token as revoked by deleting or deactivating it.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the given refresh token has been revoked or expired.
